subject.title: improve: index transcript mirror persistence checks

question: Should the three indexed writer-lock fact methods be accepted as public Plugin SDK contract for transcript-mirror consumers after the parent v12 foundation lands?
rationale: The implementation is intentionally routed through the Plugin SDK, but the added methods create a durable external API surface and the dependent schema/index foundation is not yet merged.

options.title: Accept the narrow SDK contract
options.body: Merge the parent first, rebase this child, and accept the three typed fact reads as the supported Plugin SDK seam for mirror implementations.

options.title: Keep the capability owner-local
options.body: Move the lookup operations behind a narrower owner-specific internal seam if maintainers do not want third-party plugins to depend on these writer-lock facts.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrow SDK contract
recommendation.body: Merge the parent first, rebase this child, and accept the three typed fact reads as the supported Plugin SDK seam for mirror implementations.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the related foundation and can explain the intended API boundary, while final acceptance remains a maintainer decision.
